title: Quarterly handoff: Autoscale governance heatmap & dedicated pool experiments
creator: Marina Patel
description:
Summary: Produce a prioritized quarterly roadmap artifact (heatmap) that maps autoscale policy experiments, governance guardrails, and dedicated pool commitments. The goal is a single handoff package for Eng, SRE, and Sales to run 3 targeted experiments that improve slot utilization without degrading p95 latency or customer SLA.

Why now: We have increasing requests for predictable Dedicated throughput with minimum cost overruns. Current policy surface is fragmented across runtime, billing, and routing. A concise heatmap + experiment slate will: (1) unify decision criteria for when to prefer warm pools vs burst reservoirs, (2) provide measurable experiment definitions, and (3) surface failure domains and rollback triggers for on-call.

Scope:
- Deliver a visual governance heatmap (policy x risk) covering autoscale knobs (prewarm, fastpath, hedged-reservation, burst reservoirs) and associated cost/latency impact bands.
- Define three prioritized experiments with clear success metrics, test windows, and rollback plan: 'Reservation smoothing', 'prefetch-driven prewarm', and 'dynamic burst-to-dedicated fallthrough'.
- Produce a launch checklist for Dedicated ops + SRE: dashboards, alert thresholds, canary routes, and contingency model-fallback plan.
- Handoff artifacts: Confluence experiment spec, GitHub experiment infra PRs, and updated capacity runbook snippets.

Out-of-scope: full rewrite of autoscale engine or pricing model changes; those will be tracked as follow-ups if experiments indicate need.

Key stakeholders: PM (Marina), SRE lead (Diego), Runtime Eng (Leah Chen), Billing (Omid Farrokh), Sales AE liaison (Priya Rao).
acceptance_criteria: Heatmap artifact published in Confluence with owner and version
Three experiment specs with metrics and rollout windows documented
Dashboard panels for experiment metrics exist in Grafana and linked
Runbook checklist added to Dedicated ops playbook and reviewed by SRE
At least one infra PR exists to enable gated canary routing (link to PR)
